messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: You should not take atorvastatin if you have liver disease or cirrhosis.
Atorvastatin can cause the breakdown of muscle tissue, which can lead to kidney failure. Call your doctor right away if you have unexplained muscle pain, tenderness, or weakness, especially if you also have fever, unusual tiredness, or dark urine.
Serious drug interactions can occur when certain medicines are used together with atorvastatin. Tell each of your healthcare providers about all medicines you use now, and any medicine you start or stop using.
Avoid eating foods that are high in fat or cholesterol. Atorvastatin will not be as effective in lowering your cholesterol if you do not follow a cholesterol-lowering diet plan.
Atorvastatin is only part of a complete program of treatment that also includes diet, exercise, and weight control. Follow your diet, medication, and exercise routines very closely.
Triplet: ["Atorvastatin", "requires patient instruction", "tell all healthcare providers about current medications"]

The relation 'requires patient instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'Patients are instructed to take specific actions regarding the use of medications or health monitoring as specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
B. 'should inform doctor about': Patients taking the subject drug should tell their doctor about the condition or circumstance specified by the object entity.
C. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'has overdose instruction': In case of an overdose of the subject drug the patient should follow the instruction specified by the object entity.
E. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
